hard_failures: failed forward or adjoint trace row
target, topology, material, or implementation contract mismatch
any nonzero artificial-cut displacement in a corrected history frame
acceptance_policy.historical_case_role: secondary old-boundary diagnostic only; its full-boundary/3D activation and mechanics are not a corrected baseline and do not define tau
acceptance_policy.no_skin_case_role: hash-pinned old-boundary primary control; because its boundary differs from the corrected hard-fixed baseline, the comparison is not a skin-only causal ablation

matched.comparison: corrected hard-fixed minus old-boundary no-skin; ratio is corrected / no-skin. This is a primary control comparison, not a skin-only causal contrast, because the boundary condition also differs

terminal.comparison: corrected hard-fixed minus old-boundary no-skin; ratio is corrected / no-skin. This is a primary control comparison, not a skin-only causal contrast, because the boundary condition also differs

limitations: 41 evaluations are a fixed-budget screen, not convergence
the corrected and historical activations were optimized independently
the hash-pinned no-skin and old-skin controls retain the historical boundary

the corrected target artifact is a pre-builder target contract and therefore retains prepared historical boundary metadata; the result and all history frames carry and enforce the hard-fixed solver state
nearest-fidelity matching uses saved frames without interpolation
the IsFace membrane is an open facial ROI with 707 boundary edges

seam.boundary_band: boundary vertices plus their one-ring neighbors
seam.comparison: boundary-band versus deep-interior residual and normal-Laplacian RMS
seam.policy: interpretation and visual-review evidence; not an automatic veto

metric_contract.target_area_fidelity: triangle-area-weighted vertex RMS on all-vertex IsFace triangles, reported with both rest- and target-area weights
metric_contract.target_relative_dihedral: rest-edge-length-weighted RMS deformed-minus-target dihedral on the pinned contraction ROI

artificial_cut_boundary.history_validation: all 41 corrected frames independently read and required exact-zero displacement at the bound 6,980-vertex GlobalPointId set
artificial_cut_boundary.interpretation: user-selected conservative approximation; historical and no-skin comparisons retain their old boundary and are controls only
artificial_cut_boundary.marker: source skin triangle touches mapped GroupId=-1 vertex

roi_intersection.metadata_policy: contraction ROI comes only from the hash-pinned historical surface metadata after exact IsFace topology intersection; none of its historical material arrays enter corrected mechanics

metric_surface.role: pinned geometry and IsFace/contraction masks only; historical material arrays are not used as the corrected mechanics
